review_rule: A partial opening is ready only when one bbox selects complete current N02 section features for the opened interval, an explicit station allow-list excludes every pre-existing boundary membership, selected section geometry meets the shared boundary platform at an exact coordinate, and a declared redistributable post-opening N02 release independently corroborates the alignment and station topology. Post-opening snapshots are corroboration, not event-day geometry or opening-date evidence.

route_acceptance.reason: The official segment.from_station 上小田井 is the newly opened terminus, so no route ending there can be a solved-before control. Use the adjacent 庄内緑地公園→上小田井 opening probe instead.

review.normalization: MLIT's 鶴舞線 maps to current N02 3号線鶴舞線.
review.basis: The selector contains the complete 上小田井 platform and interstation section, but excludes the pre-existing 庄内緑地公園 platform. N02-05 and the current package have identical five-decimal section edges and station geometry for the selection.

The first post-opening N02-11 snapshot and N02-12 both preserve the same eight features, four stations, and shared boundary geometry exactly at five-decimal source precision. The existing 鶴里—野並 control belongs to the officially documented 1994 interval, which remains a separate withheld opening until its historical station-name lineage is reviewed.

n02_07_preopening_control.conclusion: The N02-07 snapshot contains 二条 as the western terminus and no feature west of its platform. This is a year-vintage geometry observation, not evidence for an exact opening day.

n02_08_comparison.conclusion: N02-08 surveys the same continuous extension alignment, but abbreviates 西大路御池 as 西大路池 and assigns a shorter platform feature. The 173.586 m feature-vertex delta measures the changed split point along the same straight surveyed alignment; it is not a lateral track displacement.

n02_05_comparison.rounding_note: The selected 月寒中央 feature differs at two exact half-way longitude roundings (141.396975 and 141.396425); all selected station vertices remain within 0.601 m.

withheld.gap: Rows 008 and 026 use the opening-day boundary name 柴原, but the reviewed source set has no 柴原→柴原阪大前 station-rename event, so a historical route constrained to the official name cannot resolve. Row 026 also lacks the exact-geometry predecessor mapping required by the opening dependency: three of four selected current sections and the 蛍池 platform were redigitized at higher precision after the compiled 2020 predecessor clone.

identity.line: 国際文化公園都市モノレール線(彩都線)

withheld.gap: A complete current bbox for 万博記念公園—阪大病院前 necessarily contains the pre-existing 万博記念公園 platform because the opened branch curves west of that shared platform. The partial selector therefore cannot isolate all opened sections while leaving the boundary platform undated; retain the row until section allow-list semantics are reviewed.

The 1997 醍醐—二条 selector is spatially isolatable, but N02-05 represents 烏丸御池 with two platform features while the current package has one combined feature and 33 five-decimal section edges differ. Retain it until the junction geometry lineage is reviewed explicitly.

The 1994 opening includes 瑞穂運動場, renamed 瑞穂運動場西 on 2004-10-06. No reviewed redistributable pre-rename precise station geometry or certified name lineage is available. Current names must not be backdated across that identity boundary. The 1996 coarse legacy observation is audit-only and does not establish exact current-geometry identity.
